svg.title: F-03 guide-word scenes
svg.desc: Guide-word scenes for F-03 Recognise traffic lights. M04 Function stuck: State frozen at green while the light turns red; same response as M12 (H-06, rated as M12). M07 Functions early: Green reported before it shows; same as M12 (H-06, rated as M12). M08 Functions late: Red reported after it shows; the vehicle proceeds on a stale green as in M12 (H-06, rated as M12). M11 Delayed: Latency; a stale green as in M12 (H-06, rated as M12). M12 Inverse function: Red or amber read as green; the vehicle enters the intersection against the signal (H-06). M13 Erratic or intermittent: State flickers between colours; at its worst a green on red as in M12 (H-06, rated as M12).
svg.text: F-03 Recognise traffic lights: what each malfunction does
WP-C-03 §6.1, Figure 6-4 (F-03): the 6 safety-related guide words, 1 rated and 5 folded into another. Schematic, not simulation results.
Holds its last output and ignores new input
